description: Display-ready transform of analysis.build_opportunity_matrix's stored output: rounded values, human-readable column names, sample size always present.
signature: def build_opportunity_matrix_view(matrix: pd.DataFrame, *, min_n: int | None = None, sort_by: str = 'opportunity_score') -> pd.DataFrame
docstring:
Build the display-ready opportunity matrix.

Args:
    matrix: analysis_results['opportunity_matrix'] deserialized back into a DataFrame.
    min_n: Optional additional display-side filter on n_games, for a user who wants to further restrict beyond the analysis stage's own min_cluster_size (e.g. only show archetypes with n_games >= 10). None applies no additional filter.
    sort_by: Column to sort by, descending; must be one of matrix's own columns.

Returns:
    A DataFrame with human-readable column headers (e.g. 'opportunity_score' -> 'Opportunity Score'), numeric columns rounded to a fixed, sensible precision (z-scores to 2 decimals, dollar figures to 0 decimals, complexity/simplicity to 2 decimals), and n_games always present and never rounded away.
preconditions: sort_by is a valid column name in matrix
postconditions: Every row in the result has n_games >= min_n when min_n is given
Result is sorted by sort_by descending

edge_cases.expected_behavior: returns an empty DataFrame with the human-readable column headers already applied, not a bare empty frame

edge_cases.input: min_n higher than every archetype's n_games
edge_cases.expected_behavior: returns an empty (but correctly headered) DataFrame
raises ValueError naming the invalid column (reporting's own defensive check, distinct from a storage-layer error since this is a pure display function with no database access)

unit_tests.name: test_sorted_descending_by_default
unit_tests.description: A fixture matrix is returned sorted by opportunity_score descending.

unit_tests.name: test_min_n_filters_rows
unit_tests.description: min_n=10 excludes archetypes with fewer games.

unit_tests.name: test_empty_matrix_returns_empty_with_headers
unit_tests.description: An empty input matrix returns an empty output with the expected column headers.
